question: At the qualified R15 actual-108 state, is the phase anchor alone sufficient for collision-free nine-entity alias abstraction, or is phase paired with any one of the four derived context coordinates the minimal sufficient projection?
hypothesis: Phase alone will collapse all twenty-seven surfaces into one class because every surface has complete phase support, while each fixed two-coordinate projection [phase_anchor, derived_coordinate] will retain nine correct alias triplets, zero splits, and zero cross-entity collision pairs. Thus phase is necessary but requires one derived coordinate for collision-free identity at this state.

prior_evidence.observation: The frozen five-coordinate control induced nine correct alias triplets with zero collision. Omitting phase induced eight classes, preserved nine correct alias triplets, and introduced exactly one cross-entity collision; omitting any one derived coordinate retained the full five-coordinate membership. This is a mixed result relative to R15's preregistered phase-only-global-necessity hypothesis because the leave-phase correct-triplet metric was nine rather than seven.

scope_statement: This changes one R15 dimension: projection width is reduced from four retained coordinates to either phase alone or phase plus exactly one derived coordinate. The actual-108 stream, selected motifs, seeds, budget, exact set equality, capacity, induction, and evaluator-only audit remain fixed. It makes no population, task-learning, or language-competence claim.
authority: research-only; no deployment, external-model inference, scheduler, queue, accepted-ref, production, broker, live-interface, CKB-plane, or cross-lane authority

arms_and_inputs.full_five_coordinate_control: Exact R15 actual-108 records represented by sorted exact sets of [phase_anchor,prefix0,prefix1,suffix0,suffix1].
arms_and_inputs.phase_plus_derived_arms: Exactly four arms in order [phase_anchor,prefix0], [phase_anchor,prefix1], [phase_anchor,suffix0], [phase_anchor,suffix1]. Every arm uses identical actual-108 records and exact projected-support equality; no byte is mutated.
arms_and_inputs.evaluation: Exact projected-support equality, class cardinality, class-membership comparison, and evaluator-only entity audit; no task model is trained.

seeds.all_arms: Exact R6-R15 independent seeds; projections introduce no random draw.

controls: The local deterministic R15 probe must reproduce its observed mixed result before R16 output: full5 membership is collision-free, leave-phase has eight classes, nine correct triplets, and one collision, and all four derived omissions match full5 membership.
The full five-coordinate actual-108 control must reproduce nine correct triplets with zero splits and zero cross-entity collisions.
The phase-only arm and complete four-arm phase-plus-derived matrix run once in declared order on byte-identical actual-108 records.
Every arm has 108 records per surface and 2916 total records; only tuple projection changes.
Entity and family labels are unavailable to projection and induction and enter only the post-induction audit.
validity_criteria: Exact parent and North Star identities match.
The local deterministic R15 probe reproduces the exact observed mixed metrics before R16 output.
All five projections are constructed from identical actual-108 records; phase-only tuples have width one and pair tuples have width two; every projected tuple equals the declared source coordinates.
All arms have frozen cardinality, valid byte ranges, finite metrics, and exactly 36 unordered entity pairs audited per evaluated arm.
Full Go regression passes before the probe.
No tokenizer, task training, external model, network call, capacity growth, fuzzy matching, seed search, adaptive arm selection, or evaluator leakage occurs.

classification_rules.phase_plus_any_derived_minimal_sufficien: Validity and controls pass; phase-only collapses to one class with all 36 cross-entity collision pairs, while all four phase-plus-derived projections exactly retain full-five-coordinate membership.
classification_rules.derived_coordinate_specific_sufficiency: Validity and controls pass; phase-only is not collision-free and at least one but not all phase-plus-derived projections retain full-five-coordinate membership.
classification_rules.phase_alone_sufficient: Validity and controls pass; phase-only retains full-five-coordinate membership.
classification_rules.no_tested_pair_sufficient: Validity and controls pass; phase-only is not collision-free and none of the four phase-plus-derived projections retains full-five-coordinate membership.
classification_rules.mixed: Validity and controls pass but none of the preceding rules applies.
classification_rules.negative_control_failure: The frozen R15 replication or full-five-coordinate control fails.
classification_rules.incomplete: Compute interruption prevents the fixed phase-only and four-pair matrix.
classification_rules.invalid: Any identity, construction, arm-cardinality, projection, leakage, evaluator-boundary, determinism, finite-metric, or qualification criterion fails.

stop_conditions: Stop invalid before science on identity, R15 replication, full-five-coordinate control, projection construction, build, or frozen-package drift.
After R16 output begins, complete the phase-only arm and all four fixed pair arms unless infrastructure prevents it.
Do not add or omit coordinates or projections, inspect alternate subsets, or alter controls, metrics, thresholds, budgets, capacity, or classification after observing R16 output.
no_post_result_tuning_rule: No arm, coordinate subset, budget, context distribution, sample sequence, seed, representation rule, class learner, control, metric, threshold, capacity, stop condition, or interpretation may change after primary R16 output.
